reviewer: Independent raw-capture review by an implementation participant; not an external blind audit.
scope: All 156 output captures, including 26 warmups; 312 complete streams recounted. All 78 JSON captures parsed.
assertions: Every recomputed stream byte count, SHA-256, line count, and tiktoken count matches the original measurement file.
All five-sample medians, noise fractions and drift fractions independently recompute from raw samples.

All result-local native references and reader declarations resolve uniquely; no nested duplicate native tables occur in candidate result documents. Schema definitions are not mistaken for result instances.

Expanding reader declarations reconstructs baseline audiences in their exact order and per-reader state/reason facts; availability rows compare by agent identity. Physical ownership, addresses, aliases, configured consumers, proof, mechanism, and reasons remain equal.
Subject/unit associations are checked independently, so mere reference existence is insufficient.

Across all six publication repetitions, all three outcome identities, source-state/provenance, visibility and non-archive fields remain equal. Included/excluded path records, warnings, archive sizes and integrity are equal; only unmatched inherited rule explanations are replaced by a count.
